item_name: Rothco Enhanced Molded Open Style Handcuff Case
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Enhanced Molded Open Style Handcuff Case is the ideal solution for securely storing and accessing your handcuffs while on duty. Designed to accommodate both standard and linked cuffs, this handcuff case offers reliable, quick access when you need it most. The durable molded construction ensures long-lasting use, while the secure metal snap closure keeps your handcuffs safely in place. For easy integration with your duty gear, the case features a metal clip that mounts securely to your belt.
